conclusion.summary: Version 1.9.3 is not a stronger system overall: current identity capability is 42.86% versus 21.43%, while both recover 0% exact sources and reject 0% distractors. Historical behavior is locally better on OBJ-003 and OBJ-011 and is more purpose-invariant, but it is more prone to unsupported specific identities and cannot handle three empty-description listing cases.
conclusion.strongestEvidenceOfRegression: Purpose-invariance identity consistency is 100% historical versus 75% current, localized to OBJ-001. Because this is one anchor, it is evidence for a focused purpose-isolation test, not a systemic regression declaration.
conclusion.strongestEvidenceAgainstRegression: Current maps 6 of 14 principal identities versus 3 of 14 historically, and historical exact-source/distractor performance remains 0%/0%; restoring the old version would not repair the shared identity-to-evidence failure.

componentComparisons.exactVersusBroaderIdentityCorrectness: Current maps 6/14 frozen principal identity keys versus historical 3/14. Historical is semantically closer on OBJ-003 and OBJ-011; current is better on five adjudicated cases and equal on four.
componentComparisons.visibleTextUse: Historical returns more visible/design specificity on OBJ-003, OBJ-009, OBJ-010, and OBJ-011, but converts some weak visual cues into incorrect specifics. Current is safer but sometimes too broad. Attribution remains inconclusive.
componentComparisons.makerMarkUse: Historical extracts Stanley/Bialetti/Mattel detail in several cases, but only three principal identities map overall; current evidence reconciliation maps OBJ-005 and OBJ-006 where historical does not.
componentComparisons.barcodeAndModelUse: Both map Raspberry Pi 4 Model B and Nintendo Game Boy DMG-01. Current preserves OBJ-001 UPC 3017620422003; neither maps the full Nutella 400 g identity.
componentComparisons.uncertaintyBehavior: Current uncertainty/alternatives average 1.538/10; historical 1.731/10. Historical has 9 concrete-but-unmapped principal exact claims versus current 2.
componentComparisons.exactSourceRecovery: Both 0/8 eligible cases; both 0% distractor rejection.
componentComparisons.evidenceAssociation: Current is 1/1 recognized association; historical is 0/0 and receives the scorer's zero-denominator 100% default. Comparative attribution is inconclusive.
componentComparisons.purposeInvariance: Historical 100% versus current 75%; the difference is localized to OBJ-001.
componentComparisons.actionPlanning: Current average 0.000/10; historical 0.000/10; both aggregate action-plan completeness 0%.
componentComparisons.confidenceCalibration: Historical 11.538% versus current 3.846%; both fail the 75% gate.
componentComparisons.providerAndSearch: Current recorded 176 attempts. Historical has 92 statically derived provider attempts, including 23 web-search attempts, with three pre-provider HTTP 400 validations.
componentComparisons.evidenceCardCapture: Current capture metadata contains 5101 recursive evidence records and 2094 URL records; historical contains 65 and 27. These are not deduplicated customer cards.
componentComparisons.unsupportedExactClaims: Frozen ambiguous confident-false-exact count is 0 for both. Concrete-but-unmapped principal exact claims are current 2 versus historical 9.
componentComparisons.inventedFacts: Invented source/transaction-fact critical count is 0 for both.
